adapters.hints: On /overview press 'API Keys'. On /api-keys press 'Create key', type grunt in 'Alias', leave 'Spend limit' and 'Expiration date' empty, press 'Create'. The new key is shown once in the dialog; press its 'Copy' button so it is stored, then finish. Never press a 'Revoke' button.

On /dashboard press 'API keys … Manage keys'. On /dashboard/api-keys press 'Show plaintext key'. A dialog asks for a code sent by email: press 'Send code', open the verification email that arrives in the Squire email's inbox, type its code, press 'Verify'; the key is then shown. Do not press '+ New key', 'Edit' or 'Revoke'.
On console.mistral.ai/codestral/cli/authenticate press 'Authorize'. When the page then shows no controls, the CLI pairing is done: finish.

The account's project named grunt is the owned project. Open it, then 'Settings' in the project sidebar. When no Agent observability switch is offered there, the project is ready and this task is complete.

On /keys the Grunt key grunt-free-pollinations is listed. Press its 'Edit secret key', confirm Budget is 0, 'Quest balance only' is checked and only 'Generate' is on, then press 'Save'. Saving those settings completes this task. Only if no grunt-free-pollinations key is listed, press 'Create', type grunt-free-pollinations in Name and 0 in Budget, check 'Quest balance only' and press 'Create'; the new secret is then shown.

On /sign-in press 'Continue with Google' and choose the Squire-connected Google account. Leave 'Username or email' and 'Password' empty; they belong to password login, not to Google sign-in. After sign-in open /dashboard/apikeys and create one key named grunt; the shown key is stored automatically.

On /overview open 'API Keys' (/keys). Press 'Buat API Key' (create), open 'Pengaturan lanjutan' (advanced), choose 'Model tertentu' (specific model) and the model this goal names, type grunt as the name, press the create button. The new key is shown once: press its copy button so it is stored, then finish. Never press 'Ganti key' (rotate) or 'Cabut key' (revoke).

On /dashboard press 'Create a key' (for your coding agent or team), then 'Create key'. In the dialog type grunt in 'Name', keep 'Inference' and 'USD' selected, type 0 in 'Spend limit' and leave 'Limit resets' unset, then press 'Create key'. The new key is shown once: press its copy button.

On /keys type grunt in 'Key name'. Keep 'Free · prompts kept' selected. Scroll down to the 'I agree to the Terms' checkbox if it is below, check it, then press 'Create key'. The new key (prefix sk-gm-free-) appears with a 'Copy key' button: press 'Copy key'.

On /account/signup type the Squire email in the email field and a new password in the password field, choose 'Google Search' in 'Select an option', then press 'Create Account with $0.50 free-model credit'. A verification email arrives at the Squire email: open its link or type its code. Then create one key named grunt and press its copy button.

On the home page press 'Mulai Gratis' (start free). The register form at /masuk?mode=register asks, top to bottom: 'Nama Anda' (name: type grunt), email (type the Squire email, then press 'Kirim OTP' and type the code from the email that arrives), 'username' (type grunt), password 'Min. 12 karakter' (a new password), and an optional referral field (leave it empty). Press 'Daftar sekarang' (register). Then create one key named grunt.

On /login.html press 'Continue with Google' and choose the Squire-connected account. Then open 'Chat' (/chat-app/) and press 'Dashboard': the account API key is shown there with a 'Copy' button. Press 'Copy' so it is stored, then finish; there is no create step.
On /signup the 'Email' field appears after the page loads. Type the Squire email in it, check the Cloudflare checkbox below it, press 'Create my key', then press the new key's 'Copy key' button.

On github.com/login/device/select_account press 'Continue as' the account Squire uses for GitHub. On /login/device type the device code from this goal into the 'User code' boxes (one character each), press 'Continue', then 'Authorize'.
